description: The managed-launcher wiring for a web-chat surface that drives the harness (CRM Builder's chat-service is the reference). Every coupling is a value in the consuming project's harness.config.json `launcher` block, so this adapter carries configuration and documentation, not code.

sessionDirEnv.note: the launcher-owned session dir, which is NOT the recomputed /tmp/<repo>/<id> path

turnSentinelDir.note: where the Stop hook drops pty-turn-done-<sid> so the launcher knows the turn ended

postCheckoutScript.note: run by the merger after checkout to materialize the app variant; the guard makes it merger-only

logsDir.note: the one directory agents may redirect output into, besides /dev/null

personaInjection.note: the web-chat orchestrator is this plugin's orchestrator with a non-technical persona layered on by the launcher. The core never hardcodes a persona.

note: Leave the launcher block out of harness.config.json (the default) and every consumer above is inert: no directory is created, no path is hardcoded, no guard clause fires. Nothing in the core needs this adapter to be present.
